definitions.gloss: lady; gentlewoman; woman of refined character
definitions.explanation: A woman of good breeding and graceful manners. Used in formal or literary contexts to describe an elegant, well-mannered woman.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{淑女|しゅくじょ}のようにふるまった。
{紳士|しんし}{淑女|しゅくじょ}の{皆|みな}さま、ようこそ。
{祖母|そぼ}は{昔|むかし}から{淑女|しゅくじょ}としての{教育|きょういく}を{受|う}けてきた。
examples.english: My grandmother was raised with the education of a lady from a young age.

notes: The pair word of {紳士|しんし} (gentleman). Most commonly encountered in the phrase {紳士|しんし}{淑女|しゅくじょ}の{皆|みな}さま (ladies and gentlemen). In everyday speech, {女性|じょせい} (woman) is far more common; {淑女|しゅくじょ} is reserved for formal, literary, or old-fashioned contexts. It carries connotations of elegance, modesty, and good upbringing.
